evidence.evidence_text: Constituency parsing involves analyzing a sentence by breaking it into sub-phrases, or constituents.
We introduce a new metric, the Entity Violating Rate (EVR), to quantify the extent of entity violations in parsing results.
Experiments on three popular datasets-ONTONOTES, PTB, and CTB-demonstrate that our model achieves the lowest EVR while maintaining high precision, recall, and F1-scores comparable to existing models.
